THE FILE AREA TABLE
A file area table exists for each IOD card, containing the information from the IOD card, and
also containing information obtained from an interrupt received for the specific file. The file
area tables are constructed by the Move routine in I-O assignment just before the Go phase of
a program. File area tables exist for the MCP IOD cards. A file area table consists of seven
words (Figure 148), and its format is as follows:
